title: The Sea
tone: One sea line carried around the world, from Hokusai's wave to Van Gogh's night, who admired the wave; land rises out of the sea and sinks back into it.

episodes.title: The Great Wave off Kanagawa, c. 1831
episodes.scene: Hokusai's wave towers over the boats, Fuji small behind.
episodes.keyImage: The wave curling over the sea line.

episodes.title: Fine Wind, Clear Morning, c. 1831
episodes.scene: The same mountain, alone in the morning.
episodes.keyImage: Fuji rising from a low shore.

episodes.title: The Moai of Ahu Tongariki
episodes.scene: Across the Pacific, a row of stone figures turns its back to the sea.
episodes.keyImage: The row of moai on their platform.

episodes.title: Liberty Enlightening the World, 1886
episodes.scene: A harbour, a raised torch, a welcome from the sea.

episodes.title: The Starry Night, 1889
episodes.scene: Van Gogh, who wrote of Hokusai's wave, paints the sky in swirls.
episodes.keyImage: The cypress, the swirling sky, the village below.
